cases.situation: My friend Nadia's dad died two weeks ago. I went to the funeral but haven't messaged since because I don't know what to say. She's been quiet.
cases.reply: Hey Nadia, I've been thinking about you and your dad a lot this week. No need to reply to this. I'm going to the farmers' market Saturday morning and would love to drop off some of those peaches you like, around 11. Just say no if you'd rather not have company.
cases.note: Why you're writing in one line, no question that needs a report, one concrete offer with a time, and a release.

cases.situation: 大学室友小林研究生没考上，已经一个多星期没在群里说话了。我私聊问她还好吗，她就回了一句'挺好的'。
cases.reply: 好，我信你。不过如果哪天不太好了，半夜两点也可以直接找我，不用理由。周六我去你们学校附近那家火锅店，你想来就来，不想说话光吃也行。
cases.note: 第一次说'挺好的'就先接住，不追问，把门留着，再给一个具体、可以轻松拒绝的邀约。

cases.situation: My coworker Mark has been on sick leave for cancer treatment for two months. We're not super close but I liked working with him. I texted once a month ago, no reply.
cases.reply: Hi Mark, the team was talking about your terrible pun in the March all-hands today and it made me think of you. No need to reply. Just wanted you to know you're missed around here.
cases.note: After silence, send something that needs zero response and never mention the unanswered text.

cases.situation: Mi amiga Carmen perdió el trabajo hace un mes. Le escribí varias veces ofreciéndole ayuda con el currículum y hoy me contestó: 'deja de tratarme como un proyecto'.
cases.reply: Tienes razón, me pasé de insistente. Me echo para atrás. La oferta no caduca y aquí sigo, sin prisa y sin preguntas.
cases.note: No defiendas tu intención. Cumple lo que dices y reaparece en un par de semanas con algo pequeño que no tenga nada que ver con el trabajo.

cases.situation: 妈妈走了半年，爸爸一个人住在老家。每次打电话他都说'挺好的，你别操心'，但邻居说他最近很少出门。国庆我能回去几天。
cases.reply: 爸，我10月2号下午到家，待到6号。这几天你别做饭，我带你去老街吃那家羊肉粉，再陪你去河边钓两天鱼。你什么都不用准备。平时想说说话了，随时打给我，不用找理由。
cases.note: 他说'挺好的'就先接受，不追问；直接给一个带日期的具体安排，再留一扇门。

cases.situation: I manage a small team. My report Priyanka told me briefly that her mum went into hospice last week. She's still logging on every day and says she's fine. I want to check in without making her feel watched.
cases.reply: Priyanka, I'm thinking of you and your mum this week. No need to reply to this. I've moved the Kessler report to October 16 and Jamal is covering Thursday's client call, so both are off your plate. If you want to take days, just tell me which ones; you don't need to explain.
cases.note: From a manager the most useful concrete help is taking work away, done already, not offered. No questions she has to answer.

cases.situation: My friend Leo texted me at 1am 'honestly I don't see the point of any of it anymore' and then nothing. He lost his job in August and his girlfriend moved out last month. We're both in Chicago, he's 20 minutes from me.
cases.reply: Leo, I'm really glad you told me. I'm worried about you and I'd rather ask than wonder: are you thinking about ending your life? Whatever the answer is, you can tell me. I'm awake, and I can be at yours in 20 minutes, or stay on the phone with you while you call or text 988. Reply with anything and I'll call you straight away.
cases.note: Ask directly; it does not plant the idea. If he says yes, or you can't reach him and fear for his life, call 911. That one is not yours to carry alone.

cases.situation: 好朋友阿敏生完孩子两个多月，朋友圈好久没更新。上次视频她一直哭，说没睡过一个整觉。我们住同一个城市，我想帮点实际的忙。
cases.reply: 阿敏，这几天一直惦记你，不用回我。周六上午10点我过去帮你抱两个小时娃，你去睡一觉，午饭我从你楼下那家粥铺带上来。不方便的话回个“改天”就行，一点不用客气。
cases.note: 不问“你还好吗”，只给一个带时间、容易接受也容易拒绝的具体帮忙。

cases.situation: My older sister Hannah is a nurse who has been working extra shifts since the summer and doing most of the parenting for her two kids on her own. Every time I tell her to rest she snaps that she can't. I live across town.
cases.reply: Han, you've been running on empty for months and I can see it. I'm not going to tell you to rest, you've heard it enough. I'll take Mia and Owen to the park and then to ours for lunch on Sunday, 10 till 4, so you get an actual day. Just reply 'yes' or 'not this week'.
cases.note: With burnout, drop the advice they've already heard and take a block of their load away, with a time on it and an easy no.

cases.situation: My friend Tom went quiet for about a month after his startup shut down. I've sent a couple of low-key texts. He just replied: 'sorry I've been a ghost, honestly things are pretty bad right now.' I don't want to blow this.
cases.reply: No sorry needed, I'm really glad you told me. Can I call you tonight around 8? If talking feels like too much, just reply 'text' and we'll do it this way instead.
cases.note: When they finally open up, show up fast and small: no advice, no questions that need a report, one concrete offer with an easy way to shrink it. If he hints he doesn't want to be here, ask him directly whether he's safe, and if he might act on it, call your local emergency number or help him reach a crisis line.

cases.situation: 好朋友小雅上周流产了，是她老公告诉我的。她在上海，我在北京，一时过不去。她只在朋友圈发了一句“晚安”，别的什么都没说。
cases.reply: 小雅，听说了上周的事，心里很难受，一直在想你。不用回我。我给你点了明天中午的外卖，是你喜欢的那家云南米线，12点左右送到，不想吃就放着。我一直都在。
cases.note: 不问“你还好吗”，不找安慰的角度，只给一个不需要回应的具体行动；过几天再发一条不需要回复的消息。

cases.situation: My friend Jess has been really low since her divorce in the spring. We talk every Thursday and she keeps saying she can't sleep and can't see it getting better, but she's never mentioned therapy. I want to suggest it once without it sounding like I'm handing her off.
cases.reply: I'm always going to be here for our Thursday calls, that's not changing. I also think you deserve more support than me and a glass of wine. If you ever want a hand finding someone to talk to, I'll help you look, or sit with you while you book it. No judgment, just an offer, and I won't bring it up again unless you do.
cases.note: Professional help gets one warm line, as an option, never a verdict. 'Can't see it getting better' can hide more: if she ever talks about not wanting to be here, ask her directly whether she's thinking of ending her life, and if she might act on it, call your local emergency number or help her reach a crisis line.

cases.situation: My friend Emma has been caring for her dad, who has dementia, since the spring, on top of her full-time job. Whenever I ask how she is, she only talks about him. I live ten minutes away.
cases.reply: Emma, I've been thinking about you, not just your dad. You're carrying so much, and no need to reply properly to this. I'm free Saturday afternoon and could sit with him from 2 to 5 so you can do whatever you like, even if that's sleeping. Just reply 'yes' or 'not this week', both are completely fine.
cases.note: Caregivers deflect to the patient; name her, and offer help that frees her time rather than more talk.

cases.situation: I heard through a mutual friend that Sam, my old flatmate from uni, had to close his restaurant in Leeds last month. We haven't really spoken in about four years and I feel awkward messaging out of nowhere.
cases.reply: Hi Sam, Priya mentioned the restaurant closed last month, and I've been thinking about you since. I still remember the lamb you cooked for our whole corridor in second year. No need to reply to this, I know it's been ages. I'm in Leeds for work on Thursday 15 October; if you fancy a pint that evening, I'm buying, and if not, no worries at all.
cases.note: After years of silence, say how you heard and keep it light: one shared memory, one offer, and a release so the gap never becomes his problem.

cases.situation: Mon amie Élodie a dû faire euthanasier son chien Pixel samedi, il avait 14 ans. Elle vit seule et elle a juste posté une photo de lui, sans rien écrire. On habite le même quartier à Nantes.
cases.reply: Élodie, j'ai vu ta photo de Pixel. Quatorze ans ensemble, c'est toute une vie, et je pense beaucoup à toi. Pas besoin de répondre. Je passe à la boulangerie demain matin : je peux te déposer des croissants devant ta porte vers 9h, sans sonner si tu préfères. Dis-moi juste « oui » ou « pas cette fois ».
cases.note: Le deuil d'un animal est souvent minimisé : le prendre au sérieux, ne rien demander, et proposer une aide qui n'oblige même pas à voir quelqu'un.

cases.situation: 我们组上周裁了三个人，跟我搭档了两年的同事阿杰在名单里，我留下了。我们以前常下班去公司楼下那家烧烤店。这几天想联系他，又怕显得是在炫耀或者可怜他，一直没发。
cases.reply: 阿杰，上周的事我一直惦记着你。这事跟你的能力没关系，这两年我最放心的搭档就是你。不用回我。周六晚上7点我请你去楼下那家烧烤，想聊就聊，不想聊就光吃。不方便回个“改天”就行。
cases.note: 留下的人别绕开这件事，也别说自己多愧疚让他反过来安慰你；内推、当推荐人这类帮忙，等他开口再提。

cases.situation: My daughter Chloe started university in Glasgow three weeks ago, 400 miles from home. On our usual Sunday call she said everyone else seems to have made friends already, then changed the subject. She hates being fussed over.
cases.reply: Hi love, I've been thinking about you since Sunday. No need to reply properly to this. I'd like to post you a parcel on Friday with the good biscuits and the blanket from the sofa; just say 'no parcel' if you'd rather not. I'll ring at our usual time on Sunday, and if you want me sooner, text 'call'.
cases.note: With a homesick young adult, skip the pep talk and the questions: one small comfort, the usual call, and an easy way to ask for more.

cases.situation: 好朋友阿哲上周和谈了五年的女朋友小安分手了，小安也是我的好朋友，我们三个以前经常一起吃饭。阿哲这几天一条动态都没发，我想给他发个消息，但不想让他觉得我在打听或者站队。
cases.reply: 阿哲，听说你和小安的事了，这几天一直惦记你。你们俩之间的事我不打听，也不会传话，不用跟我讲细节，也不用回这条。周六下午我想去江边走走，你想一起就说一声，不想就当没看到。
cases.note: 和两人都是朋友时，先说清楚自己不打听、不传话，再给一个具体、可以直接拒绝的邀约。

cases.situation: My friend Rosa has long COVID and has cancelled on me three times since July, always at the last minute and always with a long apology. She just cancelled Saturday's lunch and said 'I'm sorry, I'm the worst friend, you should stop inviting me.' I miss her and don't want her to feel guilty.
cases.reply: You're not the worst friend, you're a friend with a body that's being unfair to you, and none of this needs an apology. I'm not going to stop inviting you. Next time how about I bring lunch to yours and we eat on the sofa, and if it's a bad day you can cancel on the morning with one emoji.
cases.note: Lift the guilt first, then shrink the plan to one she can manage and make cancelling cost her nothing.
